Name: Rosy Picket Fences
Author: wabiii
Description:
[list]
[*][size=3]Adds in recolours for the wooden fence in white, pink and brown with flowered versions[/size]
[*][size=3]There are regular gates and archers/arbors ![/size]
[/list]
[size=3]   I'm aware there's already a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/404]picket fence [/url]mod but I wanted to design my own with some flower versions etc alongside it !
   This is for AT or CP but I would recommend the AT version more as you can use many colours etc alongside each other.
   The CP version has a config to change colours and variations.
